COCODEMER's proprietary technology.
A distinctive multi-layer nano-gel emulsion encapsulation technology holds the core actives — coconut water, phytosterols, 20 amino acids and honey extract — in a stable complex, then designs them into a skin-compatible liposomal form that mirrors the structure of the skin itself, maximising delivery efficiency.
By strengthening cohesion between skin cells, the L-Codemar Elixir™ solution helps restore a compromised barrier and forms a robust protective film, so hydration lasts.
